verdict.rationale: BILL's own Spend & Expense marketing claims AI-powered spend management that automatically categorizes transactions and keeps them compliant. That is a thin, first-party claim covering only the categorization part of the story. The Invoice Coding Agent applies to AP bills rather than expenses, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: receipt reading/OCR, AI-suggested memos, duplicate detection, expense fraud detection, in-depth docs on how AI coding works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
